title: 3 months in, the whole game works, but it looks wrong. So I'm redesigning the art.
author: nikitagr
selftext:
I've had this game idea for a long time, and I've been building it for about 3 months, on and off. I really want to finish it for myself, even if no one ends up playing it.
    
    
    I started with a picture of how a battle should feel, and I didn't even know what genre I was making. It ended up being a dungeon crawler.
    
    
    The whole game is built now: cards, fights, enemies, the full loop. I started with a dark, realistic look because I want the game to be hard, and I don't love how it looks. So I'm redoing the art from scratch before I build anything more on top of it.
    
    
    What I considered:
    - 
    **First or third person:**
     I'm leaning first person, with your shield and sword hand on screen. There is one mockup with 3rd person view.
    - 
    **2D or 3D:**
     I dropped 3D. Each character is only ever seen from one side, so a full model buys me very little.
    - 
    **Pixel art:**
     I looked at it too, but I preferred how images look.
    - 
    **Where I landed:**
     2D with parallax. The scene is built from layers (sky, wall, floor, enemies, pillars, hands) that move at different speeds, so a flat painting gets depth.
    
    
    I'm testing styles by building each one under the real fight UI and recording it. The video shows one real fight with the style switching every few seconds: dark painted fantasy, bold ink, paper theatre, storybook and a pencil field journal.
    
    
    My wife loves "ink and banner". I really like "paper theatre", but it's third person and I was leaning first person.
    
    
    The art is AI generated. I cut out the layers and assemble them myself. The music is a free CC0 track.
    
    
    Which style reads best to you? Does a hard game need to look dark?

comments.author: Heavy_Extent_3863
comments.body:
"The art is AI generated. " No way, really? 


...just kidding. Everyone and his grandmother sees this and it really looks like absolutely garbage. The main problem here is you are looking for some art style but you have no idea about design or graphics at all. 

If you want to save this, find some who has at least some knowledge about design.
